$comment: The backend contract: what MemoryBackend and the Rust backend must both do, in the UI's terms (Backend calls, subscriptions, events). Run on MemoryBackend by contract.test.ts and on the real TauriBackend over the Rust commands by contract.tauri.test.ts. contractRunner.ts documents the step kinds, the matchers and the $variables.
